evaluation_protocol.scaling: feature SD fitted separately on each season's training rows; no centering
evaluation_protocol.baseline: slope-recalibrated on prior seasons; raw_baseline_* reports the published probability comparator
evaluation_protocol.interval: paired cluster sandwich t interval; primary four-week blocks, sensitivity calendar weeks
evaluation_protocol.cluster_dates: tournament start dates, not actual match times; this does not repair chronology
evaluation_protocol.shuffle: descriptive heuristic only; not a conditional null or family-wise error control
evaluation_protocol.clears_line: compatibility label: positive four-week lower bound AND above descriptive shuffled line; exploratory
evaluation_protocol.2019-2026: post-constant-tuning exploratory; feature selection reused these outcomes, not untouched holdout
evaluation_protocol.2022-2026: recent exploratory sensitivity; not untouched holdout
evaluation_protocol.interval_selection: pointwise; no correction for selecting features, models or historical windows
